observations: Histopathology 2017;70(2):273-280; DOI:10.1111/his.13059. IHC cohort of 488 conventional RCC patients operated 2000–2010; analyzed cancer-specific survival/progression.

In patients without metastatic disease at presentation, cytoplasmic β-catenin positivity independently predicted postoperative progression/cancer-specific death (RR 4.017, 95% CI 2.489–6.482; P<0.001).
